---
title: "Workbenches"
subtitle: "Registered applications for persistent engineering work."
body-classes: lc-gallery-page lc-document-page
---

A workbench owns its inputs and view state inside an isolated application run.
Workers are selected and prepared explicitly; opening this catalogue does not
start a calculation.

::: {.lc-application-catalogue data-lcm-application-catalogue="" data-kind="workbench"}
:::

## Developer foundation

The reusable shell is available as a local demonstration. Its geometry,
inputs, output dock, and inspector do not dispatch numerical work.

::: {.lc-application-catalogue data-lcm-application-catalogue="" data-kind="workbench" data-visibility="developer"}
:::
